G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # separator: all-zero column
    sep=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H))][0]
    left=[row[:sep] for row in g]; right=[row[sep+1:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(left),len(left[0])
    frame=next(x for row in left for x in row if x)
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    # colored shapes from right panel: per color, bounding box boolean
    shapes={}
    cols=sorted({x for row in right for x in row if x})
    for c in cols:
        cells=[(r,i) for r in range(h) for i in range(len(right[0])) if right[r][i]==c]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shapes[c]=[[1 if right[r][i]==c else 0 for i in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # bands in left: rows fully frame -> separators
    bands=[]; cur=None
    for r in range(h):
        if all(left[r][i]==frame for i in range(w)):
            if cur: bands.append(cur); cur=None
        else:
            cur=cur or []; cur.append(r)
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    for band in bands:
        cells=[(r,i) for r in band for i in range(w) if left[r][i]==0]
